name: Roussette de Savoie

known.via: English Wikipedia "Roussette de Savoie AOC" (redirects to "Roussette de Savoie")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.
Indication Géographique Protégée, the tier below AOC. It replaced vin de pays in 2009.
France's simplest category, in use since 2010. It replaced vin de table.
There is no legal or agreed definition of old, so the words promise nothing on their own.

blurb.text: A Savoie appellation for white wine, made only from Altesse, a late-ripening grape also called Roussette.
